title: Bilder für die interne Kommunikation
slide_intent: Adapt professional principles to everyday capture so useful authentic images do not depend on a full production crew.
strategic_value: Simple guidance can help DB staff document real work clearly in internal communication.
demonstration: Expanded text sections provide five basic principles and subject-specific advice for employees, leaders, vehicles and infrastructure.
practical_value: For spontaneous internal photographs, prioritize real activity, visible context, one clear focus and usable light over strict campaign styling.

content_islands.name: Internal scope
content_islands.spec: Explain why smartphone and spontaneous internal images prioritize authentic relevant content.

content_islands.name: Five principles
content_islands.spec: Expand the guidance on work, context, focus, light and color.

content_islands.name: Subject guidance
content_islands.spec: Expand separate advice and examples for employees, leaders, vehicles and infrastructure.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that internal images are often spontaneous and prioritizes clear relevant content over strict stylistic reproduction.
reference_purposes.Application: Five principles and four subject guides provide concrete capture decisions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Avoid staged poses, obscured faces, unnatural colors and isolated catalog-like vehicle images in this stated internal context.

ingredient.name: Internal photography guidance
ingredient.role: Make everyday work clear and credible.
ingredient.application: Show real activities with their setting; keep one clear focus, readable natural light and differentiated color.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Internal spontaneous photography has a lighter stylistic requirement than campaign, image and brand photography.
